Control Objective: Demonstrate commitment to integrity and ethical values
Sample Control Activity: Management establishes and reinforces standards of conduct
Evidence: Code of conduct and ethics policy

Sample Control Activity: Security policies are communicated to relevant personnel

Control Objective: Identify and analyze risks to achieving objectives
Sample Control Activity: Security risks are documented and assessed using a defined methodology
Access to systems is restricted based on approved roles and least privilege
Evidence: Access control policy and access review records

Sample Control Activity: User access is approved and updated when roles or employment status changes
Security events are monitored for suspicious activity
Detected security events are assessed and investigated
Changes to systems are authorized tested and documented
Third-party risks are assessed and reviewed
System availability and capacity are monitored
